supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: extension visible beyond the outer eye corner on the proximal side

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between pale/white muzzle and dark black periocular/cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate 2D vertical thickness with noticeable structural droop

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: Deep V-shaped notch/cleft in the upper helix apex

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced notch in the upper right ear cartilage; heavy white hair/pigmentation on muzzle and chin
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white beard-like hair growth on the lower mandible and chin
